name: vizcite
description: AI visibility (GEO) and SEO data for your agent: how ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI answer about your brand, plus keyword research, SERPs, backlinks, rank tracking, local SEO and site audits — from your self-hosted Vizcite.

vizcite_url.title: Vizcite URL
